title: /profile loads for an authenticated user without console errors
steps: Log in as a seeded user
expectedResult: The page renders Profile Information, Notifications, Security, Account Activity, and My Projects sections with the user's real name and role badge, no unhandled console errors, and no stuck loading spinner.

title: Save Changes updates a valid name and shows a success toast
steps: On /profile, change Last Name to a valid non-placeholder value
expectedResult: A green success toast 'Profile updated' appears, and the heading reflects the new name.

title: Change Password modal opens from the Security section
expectedResult: A modal opens with Current Password, New Password, and Confirm New Password fields, each with a show/hide toggle, and Cancel/Update Password actions.

title: Notification toggle switches render and respond to a click
expectedResult: All four switches (Email, Push, Security, System Updates) render in their default states, and clicking Push visibly toggles it on/off immediately.
